neighbours.label: instructions saying how a step should properly be done or adapted (as appropriate, italicize, properly preheated)
fire: Trim the margins as appropriate for your printer before sending the file.
When you cite it, remember to underline the name of the journal in your reference list.
Revise the default values as appropriate for each customer account.
Check that the grill is properly heated before you lay the fish on it.
For a formal letter, remember to capitalize the title of the recipient.
You should tweak the spices as appropriate for the guests you expect.
Please make sure the dough is properly rested before rolling it out.
